outcome: Neonatal iron status (soluble surface transferrin receptor)
cohort: Participants included 44 mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and 44 non-GDM mothers from Al-Shifa Maternity Hospital and Mubarak Maternity Hospital in Gaza Strip.
finding: The study found significant associations between GDM and lower neonatal blood glucose, serum albumin, and altered iron status, as well as an increased incidence of cesarean section delivery and neonatal hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: GDM mothers had a significantly higher rate of cesarean section delivery (43.2%) compared to non-GDM mothers.
birth_weight: Varied (median 3.22 kg for GDM babies, 3.30 kg for non-GDM babies)
gest_age: Varied (premature delivery mentioned as an outcome)
